metadata.purpose: Baseline parameter database for reconstructing the Rupp-Eichhorn-Kieleck Ho:YAG CW 3D laser/thermal model

primary_reference.authors: M. Rupp, M. Eichhorn, C. Kieleck
primary_reference.title: Iterative 3D modeling of thermal effects in end-pumped continuous-wave Ho3+:YAG lasers

operating_point.notes: Simple quantum defect = 1 - lambda_p/lambda_l. Full heat model must also include ETU, nonradiative relaxation and radiative escape.

composition.notes: Rupp validation value. For future inhomogeneous simulations, replace scalar density by N_Ho(x,y,z).

preferred_dispersion_model.name: Zelmon two-pole Sellmeier for undoped YAG at ~21 C

notes: These are the values used in the Rupp 1.1 at.% Ho:YAG validation simulation.
Do not assume the ETU/cross-relaxation coefficients are concentration-independent over large Ho concentration changes.
For the first narrowband CW implementation, only cross sections at pump and laser wavelengths are required.

linear_thermal_expansion_K-1.source: Wynne, Daneu, Fan, Applied Optics 38, 3282 (1999), YAG at ~300 K
linear_thermal_expansion_K-1.reason: Rupp uses alpha in the thermo-mechanical equations but does not list alpha in Appendix A.

photoelastic_stress_optic.notes: Values/formulas copied from Rupp Appendix A for the chosen <111> cut convention.

cooling_boundary_defaults_from_validatio.notes: Keep these separate from bulk thermal conductivity. They represent the validation mount/boundary model.

reference_validation_setup.crystal_endfaces: AR coated at pump and laser wavelengths

source.authors: N. P. Barnes, B. M. Walsh, E. D. Filer
source.title: Ho:Ho upconversion: applications to Ho lasers

auxiliary_concentration_dependence_data.warning: P77 is a total Ho:Ho upconversion parameter and is not automatically identical to each split k_I7_to_I5 or k_I7_to_I6 coefficient in the Rupp four-manifold model. Use as validation/concentration-dependence evidence, not a drop-in replacement.

known_gaps_before_high_fidelity_model.item: Full wavelength-dependent Ho:YAG absorption/emission cross-section spectra

known_gaps_before_high_fidelity_model.required_for: high-fidelity thermal feedback at large temperature rise

known_gaps_before_high_fidelity_model.item: Exact manifold-average photon energies used in the Rupp heat-loss term
known_gaps_before_high_fidelity_model.required_for: full Stage 5 heat accounting of all spontaneous branches

implementation_policy.baseline_mode: reproduce Rupp 1.1 at.% operating point first
implementation_policy.recommended_first_pass: Keep spectroscopic coefficients fixed at Rupp values while varying N_Ho spatially by modest amounts; add concentration-dependent ETU only after baseline validation.
